g.text: KKT against all five MST comparators
Solid points: medians of twelve paired ratios. Faint triangles: two six-trial graph medians. Vertical spans: every trial-range endpoint.
Two graph seeds × one fixed scalar sampling seed; repetitions reuse each realization. Ranges are descriptive, not confidence intervals.
Lines connect measured sizes, not inferred thresholds. All 0 flagged calls retained. No normalization or historical pooling.
Dashed: parity (1.00). Dotted: strong lead (0.90). A crossover needs both graphs/clocks, an earlier loss and strong leads at every larger size.
